name: ceo-inbox-send-draft
description: Send one existing draft from the principal's mailbox, when the principal asks on a live turn or on your own in inbox triage. If asked to send two or more, first state the count, recipients and subjects in one sentence, ask "send all, or go through them?", and send only after a yes. A refusal means nothing was sent and the draft stays in Drafts, unless it says otherwise: relay it, never claim it sent. In triage, send unasked: only a reply you drafted this pass that the sending setting covers; a refusal is digested, except mailbox unavailable or setting off/on_request (report those yourself). An unconfirmed send may have gone out: check Sent first. Which draft: look across every mailbox. One candidate: send it. One per account and nothing in the conversation picks one: ask, naming both. If the conversation or instruction names the account, send that one unasked. Afterwards name the account only if the principal didn't name or imply it and drafts existed in more than one.

inputs.draft_id: string (draft ID from ceo-inbox-list/search with folder DRAFTS)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.subject: string
outputs.refusal_kind: string (on a refusal: limit, judgement or other)
